rationale: The stock has gapped down ~26% on serious fraud allegations and a class action lawsuit, creating extreme uncertainty about where fair value lies. The spread is wide at 43 bps, volume is elevated but the price action shows only two candles of data with the last print essentially at today's high after a volatile open — insufficient structure to define a reliable entry thesis in either direction. With a news-driven gap of this magnitude and ongoing litigation risk, the risk/reward is asymmetric in an unpredictable way, making a skip the prudent choice.
